long_description: The aZengear set (model CN-MF-11438) contains 4 emergency ponchos with hood. According to the manufacturer, they are waterproof and windproof and help retain body heat. The ponchos are reversible: one side is green, and the silver side can be used as a signal. The material is 28 microns thick, and they measure approx. 130 x 100 cm. As emergency gear, they suit a backpack, car or first aid bag — ideal for camping, hiking and travel.
buying_angle: Practical for hikers and campers who want lightweight emergency gear for rain, cold and the first aid backpack.
